note: C ABI: `vespera_dispatch_async` now honours the async in-flight cap (shared with JNI `dispatchAsync`, default 4096, over the cap → inline 503), and C hosts can set runtime, limit, deadline and async-cap knobs with the new `vespera_configure_*` functions (`VESPERA_ERR_TOO_LATE` once fixed) instead of environment variables.
